The river was altered by the 1980 eruption of Mount St. Helens , a nearby volcano , and subsequent flows of ash and other debris . Lake River flows from the north shore to the Columbia River near Ridgefield . Due to seasonal variation in relative river and lake levels , Lake River experiences intermittent flow reversal and flows into Vancouver Lake for considerable periods of time .
